svg.desc: Real Shop at Home commercial wrap. The original client text and wrap remain. The original photo watermark intersects the rear tyre and is intentionally retained wherever it overlaps the vehicle; the unseen tyre is not reconstructed. The van is left-facing and not mirrored. Original photo: 27-Shop-at-home-half-wrap-side-2000x1333.jpg. Native SVG clipping over unchanged embedded photograph; no AI generation or invented branding.
